body.p1: I started in architecture. Designing buildings taught me to think in systems, to care about details and to keep the people who use a space in mind. 3D tools pulled me into software, and I stayed.
body.p2: Today I'm a full-stack developer near Cologne. I build web products with TypeScript, React, Next.js and Node, and I'm adding Python and Django on the backend. I co-founded Heldio, where AI turns a learner's real goal into a personal path.
body.p3: I like small teams, readable code and products people actually use. I'm at my best when design and engineering sit at the same table.
